description: This source file defines a middleware class in C# for resolving a database user based on the HTTP context's claims, specifically retrieving user information from a database and attaching it to the HTTP context items.

classes.name: DbUserResolverMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class for resolving and attaching a user entity from the database to the HTTP context based on the claim in the user identity.

methods.name: InvokeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous method invoked to handle the HTTP request, retrieve user info based on claims, and attach the user object to the context items.
